Order of the White Eagle.
[1]Marriage and issue[edit]On October 24, 1889, Leopold Salvator married 
Infanta Blanca of Spain (1868-1949), eldest daughter of

Archduke Leopold Salvator, Prince of Tuscany (Leopold Salvator Maria Joseph Ferdinand Franz von Assisi Karl Anton von Padua Johann Baptist Januarius Aloys Gonzaga Rainer Wenzel Galius von Österreich-Toskana) (15 October 1863 – 4 September 1931), was the son of 
Archduke Karl Salvator of Austria and 
Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. 
Biography[edit]Leopold was born in 
Stará Boleslav, Bohemia, on 15 October 1863. He was a member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, and held the title Archduke of Austria. He was a Knight in the 
Order of the Golden Fleece and was awarded 
Order of the White Eagle.
[1]Marriage and issue[edit]On October 24, 1889, Leopold Salvator married 
Infanta Blanca of Spain (1868-1949), eldest daughter of 
Infante Carlos, Duke of Madrid. They had 10 children: 
Archduchess Dolores of Austria (5 May 1891 – 10 April 1974)
Archduchess Immaculata of Austria (9 September 1892 – 3 September 1971); married in 1932
